observations.body: Jesus appears in a locked room, speaks peace, shows his wounds, commissions the disciples, breathes on them, names the Holy Spirit, and speaks about forgiveness.
observations.label: The risen Jesus breathes and says, “Receive the Holy Spirit”

observations.body: The passage presents Appearing, sending, breathing, and speaking as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Appearing, sending, breathing, and speaking

observations.body: The passage places Risen Jesus and disciples beside Appearing, sending, breathing, and speaking.
observations.label: Risen Jesus and disciples

payload.posture: Read John 20:19–23 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus appears in a locked room, speaks peace, shows his wounds, commissions the disciples, breathes on them, names the Holy Spirit, and speaks about forgiveness. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: The risen Jesus breathes and says, “Receive the Holy Spirit”
